notes: Catchment is every ward whose polygon centroid is within 17.85 km of the VOBL pin (13.198909, 77.706893), haversine, measured 2026-10-27 on the 243 pinned wards: b_6 Kogilu 13.76, b_1 Kempegowda Ward 14.93, b_2 Chowdeswari Ward 16.29, b_7 Thanisandra 17.28, b_8 Jakkuru 17.49, b_5 Yelahanka Satellite Town 17.60, b_3 Someshwara 17.83 km. The next ward, b_81 Horamavu, is 17.97 km. No centroid is within 7 km. The radius is an ADR-0017 decision, not a catchment study. rides_per_arrival stays 4, the ADR-0016 placeholder, not passengers per aircraft. Yields are observed scale times amplification_factor. The denominator is the mean city-day sum of booking + done_ride + cancel_ride.

flight_arrival.notes: Inject or scale synthetic flights at the command airport. multiplier scales that flight rate and is capped by maximum_multiplier. Ride-hail lifecycles attach to injected flights only, lagged 0-60 minutes, spread across kia_catchment_wards.

flight_departure.notes: Same shape as arrival, with yield 2 and lag 30-90 minutes. Independent of arrival.

metro_disruption.notes: multiplier is a suppression factor in (0, 1]. The remaining station-hour fraction is max(multiplier, 0.2). Of the removed riders, shift_shares sends 0.15 to ride-hail and 0.30 to bus. The other 0.55 is not modelled (walk, own vehicle, adjacent station, wait, cancel). All three are assumption_driven. Evidence, checked 2026-10-27, none of it from a Bengaluru closure: Boston MBTA Orange Line 2022 closure, shuttle 40% and other buses 8% of riders, 42% unaccounted. NYC station closures, ride-hail use +2.8 to +3.3% (Pham, Ipeirotis, Sundararajan, ICIS 2019). SafeTrack Surge 1 pre-survey, Uber/Lyft or walk 3% (NTC@Maryland 2016). Toronto TTC stated preference for major disruptions, drive or taxi 16% (Lin 2017). Delhi Metro 2011 stated survey, bus almost half, auto-rickshaw 12% (Goel and Tiwari 2016). Plausible ranges are ride-hail 0.08 to 0.25, bus 0.20 to 0.45, unmodelled 0.40 to 0.65. A single-station closure sits at the high end of the unmodelled share. A whole-line peak outage sits at the low end. The bus leg adds boardings only on sampled stop calls within 1 km of the station.

custom_shock.notes: Scale synthetic output of mode at location_ref for duration. A holiday is a custom_shock with a note.
